name: pushword/snippet
description: Reusable, editor-owned content fragments and dev-registered components for Pushword CMS.

suggest.pushword/admin: Manage pages, media and users from an EasyAdmin-based back-office.
suggest.pushword/admin-block-editor: Rich block editor (EditorJS) for the admin.
suggest.pushword/advanced-main-image: Choose the main image format per page, from hidden to full hero.
suggest.pushword/api: Token-authenticated REST API mirroring the admin, OpenAPI-described.
suggest.pushword/conversation: Add comments, a contact form or any user input to your website.
suggest.pushword/docs: Pushword documentation, readable offline from vendor/.
suggest.pushword/flat: Turn Pushword into a flat-file CMS: content as Markdown in Git.
suggest.pushword/newsletter: Audiences, segmented campaigns and criteria-driven automations.
suggest.pushword/page-scanner: Find dead links, 404s, redirects and TODO reminders.
suggest.pushword/page-update-notifier: Get an email when a page is created or edited.
suggest.pushword/quiz: Interactive client-side quizzes (QCM) and personality tests.
suggest.pushword/repurpose: Turn a page into ready-to-post social carousels (PNG/PDF).
suggest.pushword/search: SQLite-native full-text search via Loupe, zero infrastructure.
suggest.pushword/static-generator: Export the whole site as static files (GitHub Pages, Apache, FrankenPHP).
suggest.pushword/template-editor: Edit Twig view files online from the admin.
suggest.pushword/version: Keep a version history of your pages and compare revisions.
